May: 2027 Budget intro
June: Budget final recommendation


Projecting out future meeting agenda items based on the Goals-

Process to collect and publish market data/Track building permits - makes sense to have these
on the agenda at the same meeting.- June/Aug.

Performance measures for housing- Sept/Oct

Property tax incentive program Oct./Nov.

 Review/update program matrix - Nov./Dec.

This would be adjusted to fit in the budget, mobile housing and Housing Plan consultant as
needed.  It bakes in not meeting in July.

May:
Review of prior year budget work session


June/July/August
2-3 work sessions on GVSA Budgets
First usually shows ﬂat budget with discussion of possible changes
Second incorporates changes that have come forward
Third is held if more adjustments are needed


September:
Final vote on GVSA budgets




Budgets are then sent to MOA to be included in municipal budget process. Revisions to
budgets may be considered during First Quarter Revisions.
